notes.title: Wait: The Patient 1.1 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.1[/h1]

Hello, apologies for this terribly late first update. 
Thanks so much to everyone who reported bugs to us and gave us feedback! 
[b]
Changelog v1.1: [/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the map to be available without looking at the map on the wall first.
[*]Optimized cache handling.
[*]Fixed table passability in room 19
[*]Fixed a faulty trigger in transition hallway that would not show the creature correctly.
[*]Fixed that the conversation for the groundfloor key can be held multiple times.
[*]Fixed a few typos.
[*]Fixed a softlock in the lecture hall that would stop you from entering the door on the right, if you hadn't interacted with it before solving the problem with the lady.
[*]Fixed a bug that would get you stuck in the red book in the lecture hall, if you read it again.
[*]Fixed a bug where you could burn the hair in the lecture hall, even after saving the lady.
[*]Fixed the far right tub in the water therapy room to be interacted with correctly.
[*]Fixed an issue, where Michael was still standing in the storage, if you re-entered the room after he left.
[*]Fixed an issue, where the last dialogue with Gilman would be repeated, when re-entering the room.
[*]Fixed a wall collision issue in the last time phase after Mr. Burman
[*]Changed a text on the second floor after the power outtage to be more fitting to the situation.
[*]Fixed an issue, where the book shelf didn't display the lower shelf correctly, which interfered with the wall code riddle.
[*]Fixed wrong description in the Controls screen for gamepad controls and added Item Overview.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the update.
We also now published a bundle with both Wait games, in case you're missing the other one.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53999/Wait_Full_Story/]Wait: Full Story Bundle[/url]

notes.title: Wait: The Patient releases on the 9th of January
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126900/88dde8be401a1f493d50857e4ba2f64278c93aac.png[/img]

Hello everyone! 

[h2]We're happy to (finally) announce that Wait: The Patient will release on the 9th of January 2025. [/h2]

We are truly sorry that it is way later than we initially said and for the lack of transparency in the meantime. If it were up to us entirely, we'd release it earlier, but as a super small indie team, releasing in December, we'd just be crushed by the big companies sales and releases. That's why we pushed it to January. We hope you look forward to it anyway. 

We wish you good rest of the week.
